object_transcript: Lovely day. Church at 10-30 Mrs Lucy Garratt lunched with us, remained in my room all the after-noon. Took a walk with Jack We sat in the park til 8-PM

title: Peter O'Reilly's Diary of 1888
creator: O'Reilly, Peter
object_transcript: Fine warm bright day. Jack accompanied me to see the Dr who ordered me to recommence the baths tomorrow & to be carried home -- Went with Jack to the Pettie Port where he assisted to catch several hundred small fish After dinner, walked with Jack & sat in the Park where we were joined by Carry & Puss

title: Peter O'Reilly's Diary of 1888
creator: O'Reilly, Peter
object_transcript: Very warm day. Recommenced my baths -- "Douche" & was carried home. After lunch we all went by boat to "Hautecombe" vistied the Abbey, monks of the St. Bernard, the Abbey restored 1834 by Chas Felix King of Sardinia. Our dear Jack left us 8-45 on his return to school.

title: Peter O'Reilly's Diary of 1888
creator: O'Reilly, Peter
description: Accounts of the baths and some illnesses. Local travel

title: Peter O'Reilly's Diary of 1888
creator: O'Reilly, Peter
object_transcript: Fine day. Douch 9-20 Accompanied by Mrs. Blakeley we went by Str from Lac Du Bourget through Canal de Savieres & down the Rhone to Pierrer Chatel, beautiful scenery the whole way. Pierre Chatel a wonderful fortress said to be impregnable - a great evening returned at 6 PM

title: Peter O'Reilly's Diary of 1888
creator: O'Reilly, Peter
object_transcript:
Queen Victorias 69th B-day
A Lovely Day. Douche at 9-20
Revd John Adams & Col.
Woollcumbe returned from Geneva. 
Walked with Carry to the Park - heard the Banc.
After dinner went to the Casino Gardens, Band, Illumination Fire works &c on a grand sclae
Ball - remianed to see the dancing.
God save the Queen

title: Peter O'Reilly's Diary of 1888
creator: O'Reilly, Peter
object_transcript: A lovely morning. Douch 9-20 Walked with Carry, inspected the baths. Bought a few photographs. Saw Dr Blanc. Paid him $100 - Francs Capt & Mrs Yate left. Drove with Carry & Mrs Blakeley to St. Innocent to see the Angora Rabbits.
source: BC Archives; Vancouver Island Local History Society

title: Peter O'Reilly's Diary of 1888
creator: O'Reilly, Peter
object_transcript:
Very Warm day. Douche 920
19- Douches in all.
Busy packing left by 4-15 train. Coloz at 5 - OC very pleasent run along up the Rhone
Delightful country & scenery
Arrived at Geneva at 7-15PM
Put up at Hotel National

title: Peter O'Reilly's Diary of 1888
creator: O'Reilly, Peter
object_transcript: Lovely day. Church at 10-30 Sat in our room enjoying the view of the Lake, a lovely & beautiful scene. Went through the Cathedral (Calvanist) sat in Calvins chair beautiful view from Cathedral tower. Calvins house Quaint old town. Puss eyes very much better. Had a good view of Mt. Blanc.

title: Peter O'Reilly's Diary of 1888
creator: O'Reilly, Peter
object_transcript: Lovely day. Accompanied by Mr & Mrs Tod (scotch) we went by Str up the Lake of Geneva - stopped at Rolle, Evian, Lausane, Montreux, Vevay, went over the old castle & prison of Chillon. Sat the Cog railway or Terretet railway at Glion. Returned to Geneva by rail. Heavy thunder & rain storm.

title: Peter O'Reilly's Diary of 1888
creator: O'Reilly, Peter
object_transcript: A lovely day. Did Geneva. The musical Machine factory & the Watch Manufactory of Patek. Phillippe & co where over 4,200 men are employed. Left Geneva at 8-PM for Paris Via Culoz, & Macon, Dijon

Went to the Panorama taking of the Batille 1789. - Lunched at Place Joan D'Arc. - Spent several hours at Bon Marche invested largely in gloves.
